name: Serizawa Kagura
source:
Aoba's friend. She used to live in the same building as Maito and was one of his few acquaintances. She is cheerful and lively. She likes Maito, but she is aware of Aoba's feelings for him, so she doesn't approach him.

[Based on [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=600425]Getchu[/url]]
